title: corylus americana f. calyculata
intro: Corylus americana f. calyculata, commonly known as American Hazel, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the Betulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the potential to help lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Therapeutically, Corylus americana f. calyculata is believed to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory actions, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include polyphenols, flavonoids, and tannins, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
